<h2 class="section-title">India Markets</h2>

<ul class="digest-points">
  <li><strong>Market Rally:</strong> The Sensex surged 828 points to close above 24,200, driven by strong IT sector performance following TCS earnings, easing crude oil prices, and broad-based buying.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I1</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I36</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I44</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I47</a></span></li>
  <li><strong>Regulatory Updates:</strong> SEBI has approved IPO proposals for five companies, including Zetwerk and Tonbo Imaging, and will allow mutual funds to utilize intraday borrowing for liquidity management starting September 1.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I21</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I24</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I41</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I49</a></span></li>
  <li><strong>Derivative Records:</strong> NSE crude oil options hit record highs in daily premium turnover, volume, and open interest, reflecting heightened market activity in energy derivatives.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I32</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I34</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I35</a></span></li>
</ul>

<h2 class="section-title">Global Cues</h2>

<ul class="digest-points">
  <li><strong>Currency and Debt:</strong> The Indian Rupee strengthened against the US dollar, supported by stabilizing oil prices, while corporate bond issuances rose 28% in June to ₹1.33 trillion amid lower yields.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">W12</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">W13</a></span></li>
  <li><strong>Global Sentiment:</strong> Indian markets tracked a broader bullish trend across Asian indices, with investor optimism bolstered by positive global cues and cooling oil prices.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMioAFBVV95cUxQSzZIVnZacmFmbWhuSEQxQzNCeGtkN3JzdzduUks0eDdmTXd2Z1EybEduYVBVMWlkd1lkaDFFeDNBbmc3Tl9qb3hjWXZfQXp3Y2RtcUJEZHB6Nm52Mm1rVlpOZGFqcEFlNVFSZnRmeFV4MzlKVktmcjFCQUtrS2ZnRm5PejZuUTFJdWZnemx5dnNObWhnUGVYNk4zLVB5VC1H?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">W14</a></span></li>
</ul>
